pages.title: Project Atlas - Launch Plan
pages.content:
## Goal
Launch the Atlas customer portal to our pilot customers.

## Launch date
Friday 20 November 2026.

## Owners
- Project owner: Arjun Mehta (Product Manager) owns Project Atlas overall.
- API migration (v1 REST endpoints to the v2 gateway): Rohan Verma.
- Staging environment and deploy pipeline: Priya Nair.

## Pilot customers
3 pilot customers: Halcyon Foods, Brightpath Clinics and Orbit Logistics.

## Risks
The billing endpoints are the largest part of the API migration.

pages.title: Atlas Architecture
pages.content:
Atlas runs on FastAPI with PostgreSQL 16. User sessions are stored in Redis.

All customer traffic goes through the v2 API gateway; the legacy v1 REST endpoints are retired once the API migration is complete.

Rohan Verma maintains the Atlas backend service.

pages.title: Beacon Metric Definitions
pages.content:
Weekly active users (WAU): distinct customer users with at least one session in the last 7 days. Internal Nexora accounts are excluded.

Activation rate: share of new customer accounts that create their first report within 14 days.

pages.title: Q4 Hiring Plan and Salary Bands
pages.content:
Q4 hiring: 2 backend engineers and 1 QA engineer.

Salary band for backend engineers: INR 18-24 lakh per annum.
Salary band for QA engineers: INR 10-14 lakh per annum.

All offers need approval from the CTO, Meera Iyer.

pages.title: Vendor Onboarding Notes - CloudKite
pages.content:
CloudKite is a monitoring tool we are evaluating. The trial starts on 16 November and pricing is per host, billed monthly.

pages.title: Project Atlas - Store Rollout Plan
pages.content:
Project Atlas is Vertex Retail's new store rollout. Owner: Vikram Shah.

Go-live: 15 January 2027 for the first 10 stores, and all 40 stores by March 2027.
